item.title: Chinese Researchers Release AscendGYM Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Huawei NPUs
item.description:
Chinese Researchers Release AscendGYM Kernel Optimization Benchmark for Huawei NPUs

Researchers from the Shenzhen Loop Area Institute have released AscendGYM, a kernel optimization benchmark designed for Huawei Ascend NPUs. The tool aims to help Chinese organizations develop custom kernels for Huawei chips, particularly important given export controls that limit access to Western semiconductors. AscendGYM evaluates performance across multiple dimensions including cross-case applicability, shape specialization, and optimization efficiency, while providing unified interfaces for compilation, correctness checking, and performance measurement through its AscendForge evaluation environment. The benchmark characterizes achievable performance for specific shapes and scenarios alongside the optimization cost required to obtain gains. According to test results, Opus 5 leads in performance followed by GPT-5.6 and GLM-5.3, with Claude Code yielding the best absolute scores while GPT performs well in Codex environments. Software like AscendGYM represents an essential ingredient for enabling China to rapidly improve the efficiency of its domestic compute substrates.

#AI #Huawei #Benchmarks #China #Semiconductors #Optimization

Source: Import AI 482: Huawei kernel benchmarks; airborne drone detection; and a national lab’s AI science benchmark

item.title: Nvidia Posts $65 B Quarterly Profit, Promises Massive Cash Returns After CEO Exit
item.description:
Nvidia Posts $65 B Quarterly Profit, Promises Massive Cash Returns After CEO Exit

Nvidia reported a record‑breaking quarter of profit and cash flow, and interim CEO Colette Kress announced plans to return all excess free cash flow to shareholders following co‑founder Jensen Huang’s resignation.

📊 Financial Highlights

  • Nvidia is “raking in $700 million in profit a day on average.”
  • Quarterly profit reached $65.3 billion, outpacing the $37.7 billion, $29.8 billion and $55.3 billion profits of Micron, SK Hynix and Samsung respectively.
  • Annual “pure profit” exceeds $200 billion.
  • “That’s how much pure profit Nvidia now makes.”
  • Projected revenue for the next quarter is $130 billion.
  • Gross margins are expected to dip to 71–72 %, with a target of 73 % next year.
  • Market‑cap fell from around $5 trillion to $3.6 trillion.
  • Share price is expected to clear $45,000 and change.
  • A $1,000 investment ten years ago is now worth over $67,000; a $15,000 investment then would be over $1 million today.
  • Nvidia could give a $1 million bonus to each of its 42,000 employees every three months without exhausting cash.

🗣️ Executive Statements

  • “Going forward, we intend to return all excess free cash flow net of strategic uses to shareholders,” Colette Kress announced.
  • “All” is “a lot more than the 50 percent baseline that Jensen promised five months ago.”
  • “From a business perspective, it’s business as usual,” she said.
  • She added that Nvidia has secured backing from customers and suppliers, “including TSMC, the all‑important firm that actually fabricates Nvidia’s chips.”

⚔️ Competitive Landscape

  • “I want to show you that Nvidia has risen so far, so fast, that rival chipmakers AMD, Intel, and Qualcomm barely qualify as competition now.”
  • In the DRAM market, Samsung, SK Hynix and Micron control nearly 90 % of capacity, yet each falls short of Nvidia’s quarterly profit.
  • Both Micron and SK Hynix lost money in 2023 because they “produced too much memory.”

💡 Why It Matters

  • The scale of Nvidia’s cash generation enables unprecedented shareholder returns and employee bonuses.
  • Even after a sharp market‑cap decline, the company’s profit growth shows the AI‑driven data‑center demand remains strong.
  • The firm’s relationship with TSMC ensures continued supply of its leading‑edge GPUs.

#Nvidia #AI #Finance #Semiconductors

Source: Nvidia’s rise, visualized

item.title: Trump visits Philippines to promote AI chip hub
item.description:
Trump visits Philippines to promote AI chip hub

President Donald Trump was greeted by beauty queens and protesters as he landed in the Philippines, where he aims to promote a proposed AI chip hub.

🔍 Overview

  • Trump was greeted by five beauty queens upon arrival.
  • A child handed him small US and Philippine flags.
  • A band played “YMCA” as dancers performed.
  • Trump is eyeing the Philippines to build chip fabs and data centers.
  • Hundreds of protesters packed streets outside the airport, bearing signs and a prop casket.

⚙️ Key details

  • The proposed hub covers 1,620 hectares (4,000 acres) and includes chip factories, mineral processing plants, and data centers.
  • The US-led Pax Silica initiative aims to secure chips and critical minerals, with at least two dozen countries signed on.
  • The Philippines and US are expected to sign a framework agreement for the Pax Silica Economic Security Zone by the end of the year.
  • The Bases Conversion and Development Authority (BCDA) expects an economic boom from the project, with potential data centers on site.
  • Human rights advocates warn of displacement of Indigenous residents and small farmers.
  • The Aeta Hungey tribe has been trying since 1994 to secure an official certificate recognizing its ancestral domain.
  • The BCDA can offer leases lasting up to 99 years to foreign developers.
  • The BCDA expects to rake in close to $1 billion USD from lease income over the first 25 years.
  • The BCDA was in talks with around 30 companies interested in setting up shop in the AI hub.
  • An American energy company is conducting a feasibility study into building a liquefied natural gas (LNG) line and plant.
  • LNG is primarily methane, a smog-forming pollutant that is an even more potent greenhouse gas than carbon dioxide.
  • The Philippine government wanted to invite Nvidia, TSMC, and Apple.
  • Most of the companies interested were “high tech” manufacturing firms.

💡 Why it matters

  • The project aims to insulate the US from China’s dominance in manufacturing semiconductors.
  • The potential displacement of Indigenous residents and small farmers raises human rights concerns.
  • The proposed hub could significantly impact the local environment and economy.

#AIChipHub #Philippines #PaxSilica #HumanRights #Semiconductors

Source: Trump’s latest land grab is an AI hub in the Philippines

item.title: DOJ and Commerce Resume Investigation into Megaspeed Amid Nvidia Scandal
item.description:
DOJ and Commerce Resume Investigation into Megaspeed Amid Nvidia Scandal

The Justice and Commerce Departments announced they are investigating Megaspeed, a Singapore-based data center company, after reports suggested the investigation had been halted last year. This renewed scrutiny follows the resignation of Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang, who reportedly had an affair with former Megaspeed executive Alice Huang, alleged to be a Chinese spy.

🔍 Overview

  • The Department of Commerce initiated an investigation into Megaspeed in 2024 for potential export control violations, triggered by suspicious activity in sensitive semiconductor diversion.
  • In May 2025, Commerce Department investigators requested records from Nvidia concerning direct or indirect sales to Megaspeed.
  • In June 2025, Nvidia placed Megaspeed on its “no sell” list.
  • Agents from the Bureau of Industry and Security, in conjunction with Singaporean law enforcement, conducted an on-site end-use check at Megaspeed and interviewed CEO Alice Huang in June 2025.

⚙️ Key Details

  • Earlier this month, the New York Times reported that a Commerce Department investigation into Megaspeed “came to a sudden halt” late last year after investigators received an email from Nvidia’s general counsel. The email claimed Commerce Department official Jeffrey Kessler gave Nvidia permission to reach out.
  • Following the report of the halt, the case was “quickly” handed over to the Department of Justice, which took the lead role in the criminal investigation.
  • The Justice and Commerce Departments state they will bring the full extent of the law against Megaspeed for any criminal conduct that may have occurred.
  • The scandal has raised questions about national security and sparked scrutiny of Nvidia’s handling of chip exports to China and Megaspeed’s possible role in moving Nvidia’s chips.

#Nvidia #Megaspeed #ExportControls #DOJ #Semiconductors

Source: The DOJ says it’s investigating Megaspeed

item.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation
item.description:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns Following Spy Allegations and Board Investigation

Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia following reports of a Chinese spy plot and the disclosure of multiple extramarital affairs. The resignation, announced on November 12, concludes a series of developments involving national security concerns, board investigations, and a significant decline in the company’s stock value.

🔍 Overview

According to The New York Times, Jensen Huang was targeted by a Chinese spy plot involving Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data center company Megaspeed. While the CEO and company spokespeople characterized the relationship as normal, reports on November 6 indicated that China’s Ministry of State Security specifically recruited Alice Huang to spy on the executive. U.S. officials suspected she was passing information regarding Nvidia’s hardware designs or White House deliberations over trade restrictions directly to Beijing. Megaspeed had previously been investigated by the U.S. Commerce Department for allegedly smuggling advanced AI chips into China.

⚙️ Key Details

The resignation followed several internal disclosures and reports regarding the CEO’s conduct:

  • Admitted Affairs: Jensen Huang admitted to an extramarital affair that raised national security concerns. A second affair was subsequently reported with Kimberly Powell, Nvidia’s vice president of health care and a direct report.
  • Misleading Leadership: According to Reuters, Huang misled general counsel Tim Teter and chief marketing officer Alison Wagonfeld about the nature of his relationship with Alice Huang.
  • Internal Reactions: Bloomberg reported that before resigning, Huang appeared “broken and shattered,” telling associates, “I’m a piece of shit.”
  • Corporate Structure: Huang managed the company with an unusual structure of approximately 60 direct reports and had no established succession plan prior to his departure.

📊 Personnel and Leadership

Name Role
Jensen Huang Resigned CEO and Co-founder
Colette Kress CFO and Interim CEO
Alice Huang Megaspeed Executive and Alleged Spy
Kimberly Powell Vice President of Health Care
Harvey Jones First Board Chair in Nvidia history
Tim Teter General Counsel
Alison Wagonfeld Chief Marketing Officer

📊 Corporate Impact

Following these developments, Nvidia’s stock price fell from an all-time high of $239.24 on October 6 to $162.85 by November 13. The company is currently facing a shareholder lawsuit claiming it deceived investors. Despite the leadership transition, Nvidia continues to manage significant capital, including $99 billion in AI lab investments and plans for $500 billion in data center infrastructure financing.

💡 Why it matters

The appointment of Harvey Jones as the company’s first board chair signals a shift in Nvidia’s corporate governance. Interim CEO Colette Kress described the transition as an “extraordinarily difficult period” for the company. The board has initiated a search for a permanent successor, evaluating both internal and external candidates to lead the company forward.

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #Cybersecurity #Semiconductors #CorporateGovernance

Source: An overview of Jensen Huang’s messy days

item.title: Jensen Huang Leaves Nvidia Following Chip Smuggling Scandals and Personal Allegations
item.description:
Jensen Huang Leaves Nvidia Following Chip Smuggling Scandals and Personal Allegations

Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has left the company he cofounded 33 years ago, ending his tenure as the visionary leader of the world’s first $5 trillion company. The departure comes amid reports of the executive enabling two chip smuggling scandals and allegations of three extramarital affairs. The news has raised concerns regarding the stability of the US AI industry and the S&P 500 index, of which Nvidia represents approximately 6 percent.

⚙️ Key details

  • Huang’s exit follows allegations of enabling two chip smuggling scandals and three extramarital affairs, including one with an alleged Chinese spy.
  • The former CEO was known for a distinct personal style, including a signature black leather jacket and an intense leadership model where approximately 60 employees reported directly to him.
  • Huang had no designated deputies and had not established a succession plan for the company.
  • Analysts have described Huang as both the visionary and tactical leader of Nvidia, drawing comparisons to the role Steve Jobs held at Apple.

🔍 Overview

  • Nvidia was cofounded by Huang 33 years ago at a Denny’s diner.
  • In 1996, the company nearly failed due to a graphics chip for the Sega Dreamcast, but Huang later convinced Sega to invest $5 million.
  • Huang focused the company on visual computing, gaming graphics, image recognition, and AI simulations.
  • Notable public demonstrations included a 2008 project using an 1,100-nozzle paintball gun to demonstrate parallel processing by painting the Mona Lisa in one shot.

💡 Why it matters

  • Nvidia GPUs are the essential hardware powering the worldwide AI boom.
  • Huang’s centralized leadership style means that his absence creates a vacuum in a company built entirely around his vision and tactics.
  • While major tech companies like Microsoft, Apple, and Google have successfully transitioned leadership, Nvidia faces a unique challenge due to the lack of internal deputies.
  • Industry analysts note the loss of a primary AI industry spokesperson and culture setter.

🚀 Future outlook

Area Current Status
Product Roadmap Locked in through 2027; next generations in design, tape-out, or on order
Supply Chain Locked up for years, including leading-edge wafers, CoWoS-class packaging, and HBM
Immediate Financial Impact Characterized by analysts as a “stock shock” rather than a business shock for the next year
Next CEO Requirements Needs technical credibility, an operating model not dependent on one person, and a plan to protect CUDA

#Nvidia #JensenHuang #Semiconductors #AI #StockMarket

Source: Jensen Huang and the decline of the visionary showman founder CEO

item.title: Nvidia confirms technical feasibility of Chip Security Act tracking measures
item.description:
Nvidia confirms technical feasibility of Chip Security Act tracking measures

Nvidia representatives have privately informed Representative Bill Foster that the company could technically implement anti-smuggling geotracking measures for advanced AI chips, despite public opposition from the Semiconductor Industry Association (SIA).

🔍 Overview

The Chip Security Act, introduced in May 2025, aims to prevent the smuggling of advanced AI chips to China. The bill is currently under consideration for inclusion in the Senate’s National Defense Authorization Act. Discussions surrounding the bill have intensified following reports of an alleged affair between Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and Alice Huang, who runs a firm currently under investigation for smuggling advanced GPUs.

🧩 How it works

The proposed legislation outlines several mechanisms for tracking chip locations:

  • Inspections of facilities.
  • Attestations provided by companies.
  • Ping-based location mechanisms, where GPUs send a signal of their location when coming online.

While the Center for Security and Emerging Technology identified the ping-based technique as the most cost-effective option, current versions of the bill would only allow investigators to identify chip locations, not disable smuggled units. Representative Foster plans to introduce further legislation requiring licenses to operate advanced GPUs, creating a workaround where a valid license must be verified before a chip can connect.

⚙️ Key details

Entity Stance / Role
Semiconductor Industry Association Publicly opposed the bill, citing it as “potentially infeasible.”
Nvidia Representatives Privately told Foster that the company could implement tracking measures.
Nvidia Fleet Intelligence A tool that monitors chip performance across data centers and can indicate which country chips are in.
Megaspeed A Singaporean firm under investigation for smuggling GPUs to China.

#Nvidia #AIChips #Geopolitics #Semiconductors #TechPolicy

Source: Nvidia privately confirmed it could track chips to fight smuggling, even as industry publicly questioned feasibility

item.title: Samsung Expands Pyeongtaek Semiconductor Complex to Reclaim Lead in AI Memory Chips
item.description:
Samsung Expands Pyeongtaek Semiconductor Complex to Reclaim Lead in AI Memory Chips

Samsung is building a massive new semiconductor manufacturing complex in Pyeongtaek, South Korea, as it attempts to reclaim its lead in the global memory chip market. The build-out in the farming city south of Seoul comes as the company predicts demand for memory chips will continue to surge through 2028 due to the AI boom.

🔍 Overview

The Pyeongtaek campus covers an area approximately the size of New York City’s Central Park and operates as a sprawling chipmaking complex where rice paddies abut the industrial facilities.

  • Operational Status: Three fabs already operate around the clock.
  • Current Expansion: A fourth fab is currently coming online.
  • Restarted Construction: Construction of a fifth fab was halted in 2024 during a drop in memory demand but restarted when AI-driven demand increased.

⚙️ Key details

The construction site employs hundreds of women, many of whom serve as spotters to ensure safety around heavy equipment.

Role Responsibilities Daily Pay
Safety Officer Overseeing crews responsible for building cable ducts 140,000 won ($97)
Spotter Walking ahead of heavy equipment 140,000 won ($97)

💡 Why it matters

Samsung is using the Pyeongtaek expansion to address shifts in the global semiconductor landscape:

  • Market Competition: Domestic rival SK Hynix has pulled ahead in the global market for high-bandwidth memory models used in Nvidia’s AI accelerators.
  • Foundry Dominance: Taiwanese chipmaker TSMC currently dominates the foundry business, manufacturing chips designed by other companies.
  • Future Demand: Samsung forecasts that the surge in demand for memory chips will persist through 2028.

#Samsung #Semiconductors #AIChips #SouthKorea

Source: A visit to Samsung’s massive new semiconductor hub

item.title: Syensqo Uses AI Agents to Develop Advanced Materials for AI Infrastructure
item.description:
Syensqo Uses AI Agents to Develop Advanced Materials for AI Infrastructure

Syensqo, a global leader in specialty materials, is employing AI agents to accelerate the discovery and development of materials designed to support semiconductor and data center infrastructure.

💡 Why it matters

According to Mike Finelli, chief technology and innovation officer and chief North America officer at Syensqo, the AI boom is becoming a materials challenge. He states that AI is pushing semiconductors and data centers toward physical limits regarding:

  • Performance
  • Thermal management
  • Electrical efficiency
  • Reliability

🧩 How it works

Syensqo uses AI agents to navigate the “enormous universe of possible molecules” through the following process:

  • Digitally synthesizing millions of potential molecular combinations.
  • Predicting the sustainability and performance characteristics of these combinations.
  • Narrowing the results to a smaller group for laboratory testing.

⚙️ Key details

Syensqo is developing various solutions to meet accumulating requirements for purity, chemical resistance, plasma resistance, high temperature, electrical performance, and long-term stability. These include:

Material Application Purpose/Source
High-voltage data center architectures Specialized materials development
Semiconductor manufacturing Advanced sealing materials
Direct immersion cooling Thermal-management fluids
Data center energy-density/voltage Materials developed for electric vehicles

Finelli suggests a reinforcing cycle where AI helps develop materials that improve AI infrastructure, which then enables better AI to further accelerate materials discovery. This approach allows scientists to go “broader, deeper, and faster” while spending more time on complex engineering problems.

#Syensqo #AIagents #Semiconductors #MaterialsScience #DataCenters

Source: Building the materials foundation for AI

item.title: NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face for $13 Billion to Expand Open-Source AI Focus
item.description:
NVIDIA to Acquire Hugging Face for $13 Billion to Expand Open-Source AI Focus

On Thursday, American chipmaker NVIDIA announced the acquisition of the artificial intelligence library Hugging Face for $13 billion (€11.2bn). The deal marks an increased focus on open-AI models for NVIDIA, which is currently the largest publicly traded company in the world by market cap following a surge in demand for GPUs in AI data centres.

⚙️ Key details

  • Acquisition Price: $13 billion (€11.2bn).
  • Platform Role: A premier database for hosting open-source and open-weight AI models.
  • Company History: Hugging Face transitioned from an age-appropriate chat app for teenagers to a central AI ecosystem player.
  • Workforce: While the deal is based in the United States, the founders are French and half of the employees are located in Paris.
  • Strategic Goal: Hugging Face aims to remain a key part of the open-source AI ecosystem in Europe.

🔍 Overview

NVIDIA has significantly increased its embrace of open AI models over the last year, offering dozens of models for free and leading policy efforts to ensure competition among LLM providers. For European innovators who lack the capital to train models at the level of Anthropic or OpenAI, Hugging Face platforms provide valuable tools for local solutions. Open models also allow governments and agencies to host custom versions locally, utilizing sensitive or protected data without relying on external infrastructure.

🧩 Industry landscape

Company Role and Description
ASML Dutch company; largest supplier of semiconductor machines integral to chip production
ElevenLabs Founded by Polish researchers; specializes in speech and voice processing models
Mistral European LLM maker covered by the EU AI Act
DeepL European LLM maker covered by the EU AI Act

💡 Why it matters

Open-source AI is presented as a solution to the transparency issues found in proprietary systems. Hugging Face co-founder Clément Delangue stated in a 2024 interview with Le Monde that “proprietary models are black boxes that make it difficult to analyse their bias or sources of truth.”

In a 2023 testimony before a U.S. House Committee, Delangue further explained, “Open science and open source AI distribute economic gains by enabling hundreds of thousands of small companies and startups to build with AI. It fosters innovation, and fair competition between all.” This accessibility allows researchers, artists, and small companies to fork, tune, and upgrade models at little or no cost.

⚖️ Regulatory landscape

The size of the deal is expected to draw concern from European Union regulators regarding digital and AI sovereignty. Competition regulators and industry watchers in Paris and Brussels may seek a review of the deal terms and enforcement of the EU AI Act. Key concerns include vendor lock-ins and the need to de-risk European systems from reliance on American or Chinese infrastructure. While building EU data centers is a priority for regulators, the software used within those centers is considered equally critical.

#NVIDIA #HuggingFace #OpenSourceAI #EUAIAct #Semiconductors

Source: Could NVIDIA’s purchase of Hugging Face boost the EU’s AI sovereignty?
